actions.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Finance.

dimensions.assessment: Affects entities that previously received distributions under the Continued Dumping and Subsidy Offset Act of 2000 and file certifications for the special distribution.
dimensions.evidence: Each person seeking a special distribution under paragraph (1) must... have received at least one distribution under the Continued Dumping and Subsidy Offset Act of 2000

dimensions.assessment: Provides a special distribution of realized interest to eligible persons on a pro rata basis.
dimensions.evidence: Interest specified under paragraph (1) shall be aggregated by antidumping duty or countervailing duty order or finding and distributed on a pro rata basis

dimensions.assessment: Utilizes existing amounts available in a specific Treasury account for funding.
dimensions.evidence: the Commissioner of U.S. Customs and Border Protection shall use amounts available for such purpose in the Refund of Moneys Erroneously Received and Covered account

dimensions.assessment: Amends specific provisions of the Trade Facilitation and Trade Enforcement Act of 2015 regarding duty distributions and interest.
dimensions.evidence: Section 605(c)(1) of the Trade Facilitation and Trade Enforcement Act of 2015 (19 U.S.C. 4401(c)(1)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Executes a one-time special distribution process with specified administrative deadlines up to 210 days after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: not later than the date that is 210 days after such date of enactment.

missing_information: Total monetary amounts available in the Treasury account or expected to be distributed are not specified.
importance_detail.rationale: Modifies interest descriptions for antidumping and countervailing duty distributions and authorizes a special distribution of those amounts using existing Treasury funds.
